trigger: After mg_black_start succeeds: the plant comes up.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The cart roars. The circulation pumps groan, catch, scream. The turbine starts to whine.

nodes.speaker: walt
nodes.text: Easy. Easy. Watch the pressure. Watch it. ...Now. Close it.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: You close the breaker. Every light in Galena Station comes on at once.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Through the window, steam rises out of the dark like a city waking up. In the steam, a tall shape stands.

nodes.speaker: wraith
nodes.text: [Wraith won't go near the window. She sits behind Walt's chair and won't come out.]

nodes.speaker: walt
nodes.text: Ha. Ha! You hear that? That's a turbine, son. That's the only good sound left in the world.

nodes.speaker: walt
nodes.text: One line out. One feeder. Where does the first power go?

choices.text: The Silver Spur. The Floor's kitchens.

nodes.speaker: walt
nodes.text: Hospital. Good. Ames will cry. He won't admit it.

nodes.speaker: walt
nodes.text: Roz's kitchens. A thousand hot meals a day. Not bad, kid.

nodes.speaker: walt
nodes.text: Avila. Okay. Lights in a room full of lists. Your call.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Across the valley, one district flickers, then holds. Everyone who sees it knows exactly what it means.
